title: Kula Today
heading: Today · Sun 01 Nov
summary: A flat day (forecast flat). Thermals were strongest (moderate) about 15:00. The upslope ran from about 08:30 to about 16:30. The evening before, the page called it low, about 4,100 ft, a miss. Midday the base averaged about 4,800 ft by the Kekoa camera, 700 ft higher than the evening's number; the morning update said about 3,900 ft, off by 900 ft. Most of the day the shear line was crossing Kula Highway near Omaopio; furthest south about 17:37, crossing Kula Highway near Waiakoa. Data gaps: Upper Kahikinui stopped at 13:35; Kahikinui stopped at 13:40; Nakula stopped at 15:15; the Mesonet could not be reached on 25 of 70 updates.
